stem: The correct IUPAC name for the compound [Co(NH3)4CI(ONO)]Cl is
solution:
Cation is named first followed by anion. In coordination sphere
the ligands are named alphabetically followed by name of metal ion and
then its oxidation state in Roman numeral.
In [Co(NH3)4Cl(ONO)]+Cl-, cobalt is in +3 oxidation state and the
complex is cationic. ONO ligands attach to metal ion through O atom;
so --O-- is used while naming as nitrito before the name of metal
ion. So IUPAC name given in option (D) is correct.
